analysis.reasonEn: Attempting to rebound after a cumulative -5.5% drop over the last 5 trading days. RSI has exited oversold territory and is consolidating in the neutral zone, while MACD histogram shows improvement but is not yet conclusive for a trend reversal. Trading volume is also subdued at 0.77 times the 5-day average. Approaching the 52-week low of $61.39 suggests potential for a rebound rather than further decline, but a lack of clear buy signals warrants a wait-and-see approach.

[거래량·결론]
